English Language Examination Requirements
At a Glance
UC Davis accepts English language proficiency scores only from the TOEFL, IELTS, and Duolingo exams. The exam scores on this page meet the minimum requirements for UC Davis admission, but individual graduate programs may set more stringent requirements in their degree requirements, and admitted applicants who are offered employment as a Teaching Assistant or Reader may be required to take an additional language exam at UC Davis and/or enroll in additional English language coursework.
TOEFL iBT
Minimum Score: A minimum TOEFL score of 80 is required for TOEFL exams taken prior to January 21, 2026 (old scoring), and a minimum score of 4.5 out of 6.0 is required for exams taken on or after January 21, 2026.
Institution Code: 4834
No department code.
IELTS
Minimum Score: 7.0 on a 9-point scale
Duolingo English Test
Minimum Score: 115

Exemption Eligibility
Applicants are exempt from the English language examination requirement if they have earned or will be earning a bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree from either:
A regionally accredited U.S. college or university where English is the sole language of instruction, or
A foreign college or university which provides instruction solely in English. UC Davis Graduate Studies will only approve waivers for foreign colleges and universities which list English as the sole language of instruction in the IAU World Higher Education Database (WHED). Exam waiver requests are not approved if English is not the sole language of instruction listed, no language is listed, or if the institution is not included in the WHED database. No other documentation (e.g. letters, language certificates, institutional websites) will be accepted for a waiver request.
Applicants who do not meet one of the criteria above are required to submit TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo exam scores to be considered for admission to a UC Davis graduate program.

Confirm We've Received Your Test Scores
It Can Takes 2-4 Weeks for UC Davis to Receive Your Scores
Please note, it takes approximately two to four weeks after the test date for UC Davis to receive your scores from the exam administrator.
Check Your Application Status Page for Updates
Once you have submitted your application, you will be able to check to see if your scores have been received by visiting your Status Page. We cannot check on the status for you.
Matching Your Test Scores to Your Application
Application Tip!
To help us match your official score reports with your application, applicants with GRE, TOEFL iBT, IELTS Academic, or IELTS Indicator scores should complete:
The "Test Score ID Information" section of the application
And also enter your self-reported scores in the "Test Scores" section
Providing this additional information will help ensure that we are able to match your official scores to your application in a timely fashion. However, depending on the exam, it may take weeks for the official score reports to be sent to UC Davis from the testing organization. Please be patient when waiting for your official scores to arrive.
